changelog.summary: An issue that prevented some KDBX vaults from opening has been resolved by improving how Keyguard parses vault data. The app now correctly reads files containing extra data after the main content block, increasing compatibility with vaults modified by other KeePass clients. This release also enhances the precision of KDBX revision handling for more reliable data synchronization.

changelog.summary: Manage GPG keys and use the integrated SSH/GPG agent, now also available on Windows for seamless integration with development tools. This release delivers a completely reworked synchronization engine for KeePass (KDBX) vaults, improving reliability and support for large attachments. Keyguard can also now act as an OpenKeychain-compatible provider on Android, allowing third-party apps like Termux to use your keys for authentication and signing operations.

changelog.summary: KeePass file watching on Android is now more reliable, particularly for files accessed via the `content://` scheme and on older OS versions. One-time password generation has been improved; exported `otpauth://` URIs are now spec-compliant and the mOTP period has been corrected to the standard 10 seconds. This release also rejects pre-login KDF downgrades, cleans up stale SSH agent state on restart, and properly binds the agent socket in Flatpak environments.

changelog.summary: This update features a major search rework, SSH agent support for Android via Termux, and the ability to import SSH keys from files. Search now prioritizes title matches and displays context as a badge. You can also batch-edit tags for multiple items. Further improvements include Bash syntax highlighting and optimized Watchtower processing. Key fixes address desktop SSH agent startup loops, `cmd://` URI handling, and gracefully handle invalid TOTP keys and SSH agent failures on Android.
